title: Keeping your data safe when an AI agent clicks a link
summary: Learn how OpenAI protects user data when AI agents open links, preventing URL-based data exfiltration and prompt injection with built-in safeguards.
body: Learn how OpenAI protects user data when AI agents open links, preventing URL-based data exfiltration and prompt injection with built-in safeguards.
summaryZh: 随着AI Agent具备网页浏览能力，如何防止其点击恶意链接引发数据外泄和提示词注入攻击成为关键安全议题。OpenAI介绍了其在智能体架构中内置的安全防护机制，确保用户数据在代理网页交互时的绝对安全。原始信息显示：Learn how OpenAI protects user data when AI agents open links, preventing URL-based data exfiltration and prompt injection with built-in safeguards.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Keeping your data safe when an AI agent clicks a link”。其重要性主要体现在：文章探讨了AI Agent在点击外部链接时如何防范数据外泄和提示词注入，对智能体安全性有重要实践价值。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
